title: Home screen for my upcoming game - fully created with AI
author: heavyc-dev
selftext:
Created with a Claude Code workflow.

  
Set base prompts for models > Concept art generation with Nano Banana Pro > Claude calls Meshy AI with concept art + added prompts > Downloads Mesh > Claude rigs mesh using headless Blender calls > Animates mesh > Imports to Godot.

  
Really happy with the results so far. Base game is nearly feature complete, although its missing some planned content. Beta coming soon!

replies.author: heavyc-dev
replies.body:
Its essentially a monster collector roguelike with pretty deep meta progression. 50 creatures on launch. Each run you assemble a team and build your roster over time but there's real stakes with the ability to fully sever the bond with a creature. I think the hook of the game is unique enough to break the mold of your typical roguelike or pokemon clone but without getting into too many details I think it honestly comes off as generic

I plan on sharing some actual gameplay soon and I'll be adding a page to my website to whenever the beta becomes available
